caseNameFull: GEER v. BOWERS, TAX COMMISSIONER OF OHIO
attorneys: H. Herschel Hunt for appellants., Mark McElroy, Attorney General of Ohio, and Theodore R. Saker and Joseph L. White, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
